## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together via the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing school gossip, classmates, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head and is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), refusing to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is humiliated by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) at school, first by being made to stand in front of the blackboard and later by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after arriving late. Outraged, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) vows never to return to school or forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), ignoring his attempts to apologize. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who recommends letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to study at home and dramatically frets over her future friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea while she is away at an [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting. When [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves her three glasses of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become dizzy and sick. The following Monday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes she intentionally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend a concert with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the two girls enjoy the night's performances and sleepover. However, they accidentally jump onto a sleeping [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in the spare-room bed, infuriating her. Upon learning the next day that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) plans to leave and cancel Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply remorseful for causing trouble.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of dainty kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) on [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning. Later that evening, the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert takes place, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shines in her recitations and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) performs a solo. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk home discussing the event, and later [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) reflect by the fire on how proud they were of Anne's performance.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends attempt to reenact the story of Elaine in a flat boat on the pond, but the boat begins to leak, forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cling to a bridge pile. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rows by and rescues her, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cold-shoulders his offer to end their feud. Afterward, back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) despairs over Anne's antics while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages her to keep a little of her romance.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to pay for Anne's extra studies so she can eventually earn a living as a teacher. After joining the class, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a mix of sorrow over [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) not joining, excitement about their future ambitions, and ongoing academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) continue their academic rivalry through the school year, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets ignoring him. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach the Queen's class next year, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to lock away her books and embrace summer vacation. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), learns about Matthew's failing health, and praises Anne's remarkable growth and beauty to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys an active summer outdoors following a doctor's recommendation and returns to her studies in autumn with renewed vigor. Over the winter, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) prepares the Queen's class for the daunting [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid growth and growing maturity, feeling a quiet sense of loss as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid a emotional farewell to Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) at the end of the school term. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) travels to town to take her Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations, detailing her nervous experiences in a letter to [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Weeks later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), revealing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island), bringing immense pride to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) looks on with quiet pride. [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) to the hotel, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially experiences severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. However, catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) sparks her determination, leading her to deliver a glowing recitation that wins enthusiastic applause and praise from the audience.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares to leave for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents her with a special light green dress, prompting an emotional moment of gratitude and shared reflection with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) travels to town and starts her studies at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), taking on the rigorous First Class course alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Settling into her new boarding-house room, she battles homesickness until visited by [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and Ruby, who share news of an Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) that instantly sparks Anne's ambition.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming close friendships and continuing her quiet academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She visits [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and stays focused as the term progresses toward final examinations. As spring arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates anxiously discuss their upcoming tests and future prospects.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading a newspaper article about the failure of the Abbey Bank. Following his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grieve together and process their shared loss. Life slowly returns to a routine, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her own past as she prepares to consult an eye specialist.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns from the oculist with news that her failing eyesight will force her to sell [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolutely refuses to let the farm be sold and forfeits her scholarship to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) so she can stay home, care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and teach local school. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) reveals that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could have it, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile and become close friends with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road
